## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 251ad374cb1027de108590bef75508f4f497b375

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log` on the files touched by the fix (`IReportProperties.java`, `ReportProperties.java`) and found only two prior commits ever touched them: `cfeac1a` (initial import/restructure) and `251ad37` ("addition parameters by terry"). I diffed `251ad37` and found it is the exact inverse of the fix commit: it removed `OUT_ENCODING`/`getOutEncoding`/`setOutEncoding` and replaced them with two new properties, `OUTPUT_ENCODING` ("html.outputEncoding") and `SOURCE_ENCODING` ("html.sourceEncoding"), wiring them into `html`/`txt`/`xml` `ReportGenerator`s and using `getSourceEncoding()` to read source files via `InputStreamReader`.

**(2) The specific bug:** The new properties were parsed with `getReportProperty(..., false, false)` — i.e., no default value — and `emma_default.properties` (checked via `git show cfeac1a:.../emma_default.properties`) was never updated to match: it still defines `report.html.out.encoding: ISO-8859-1` and `report.xml.out.encoding: UTF-8`, keyed to the old `out.encoding` property name. Since 251ad37 renamed the lookup key to `html.outputEncoding`/`html.sourceEncoding`, these defaults no longer match and the resolved value is `null` whenever a user doesn't explicitly set the new (undocumented) property. `null` then propagates into `new OutputStreamWriter(..., (String) null)` / `new InputStreamReader(..., (String) null)`, both of which throw `NullPointerException` (not the caught `UnsupportedEncodingException`), crashing report generation for ordinary/default usage.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- `git show cfeac1a -- emma_default.properties` confirms the defaults file was keyed to `out.encoding`.
- `git log -- emma_default.properties` shows no commit between `251ad37` and the fix ever updated these keys to match the renamed properties — the mismatch persisted untouched.
- The fix commit `c395707` is a near-exact revert of `251ad37`'s property renaming (`OUTPUT_ENCODING`/`SOURCE_ENCODING` → `OUT_ENCODING`/`IN_ENCODING`, restoring `getOutEncoding()`/adding `getInEncoding()`), strongly indicating `251ad37` is where the regression was introduced.

I'm confident in this attribution; the only residual uncertainty is whether `emma_default.properties` was *intended* to be updated as a follow-up in `251ad37` but simply forgotten (same bug, same commit either way), versus some other commit in between also touching encoding defaults — but `git log` shows no such intermediate commit.
